x: So far this season very satisfactory form has been shewn by our cross-country men, and Beard, Shrubb and Herbert deserve special mention for their good running in the South of the Thames Junior
Several of our younger members gave sterling accounts of themselves : Beard, Rispin, Shrubb and others, who will prove their worth in later races.

A small bunch, which included Beard and Herbert, had settled down some 30 to 40 yards in the rear, and in the long steady pull up to the Kingsmere, Herbert put in some telling work to overhaul the leader.

Trevor Hart in his first race for 5 weeks, produced a tremendous sprint finish with Beard (Hercules). Their impetus took them to the neck of the funnel full tilt and Hart's opponent was sent flying across the ropes; however, Trevor gave him the benefit of the doubt and sportingly let him take the forward placing.
Stage four was taken by Bob Smith, who despite giving his best, lost ground to Whitty of T.V.H. although he managed to overtake Beard of Hercules Wimbledon.
